jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Sportsbet is growing its Core Machine Learning team and seeks an ML Engineer to develop and maintain predictive models for sports markets, customer propensity scoring, and personalisation. You'll work with Python, MLflow, and cloud-native ML infrastructure on real-time betting and streaming data at scale.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager – AI
jobs.snippet: Xero is hiring a Lead Product Manager to own the product strategy for its AI-powered features across accounting, payroll, and invoicing for millions of small businesses. You'll partner closely with ML engineers and data scientists to ship AI capabilities including automated reconciliation, cash flow predictions, and generative document processing.

jobs.title: 2026 Data Science Analyst Program – Summer Analyst
jobs.snippet: JPMorgan Chase's Data Science Analyst Program recruits final-year students to work on quantitative research, risk modelling, and applied ML across trading, consumer banking, and asset management in Sydney. The programme offers exposure to production financial systems and large-scale datasets within a global investment bank.

jobs.title: AI Innovation and Agent Engineer
jobs.snippet: Adobe is hiring an AI Innovation and Agent Engineer in Sydney to design and build next-generation agentic AI workflows for Creative Cloud and Document Cloud. You'll integrate LLMs, construct multi-step AI pipelines, and collaborate with product teams to deliver AI-native creative tools used by hundreds of millions of people globally.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.snippet: Datadog is hiring a Senior AI Engineer in Sydney to build AI-powered observability features including anomaly detection, log intelligence, and AIOps capabilities. You'll develop ML models that run on Datadog's global cloud monitoring platform and work on infrastructure data at internet scale.

jobs.title: AI Engineer – AI and Data
jobs.snippet: EY Australia's AI and Data practice is expanding and seeks an AI Engineer to design and implement AI solutions for enterprise clients across financial services, government, and healthcare. You'll architect and deploy LLM-based applications, generative AI workflows, and data platforms as part of large digital transformation programmes.

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Analyst – Engineering
jobs.snippet: Goldman Sachs invites penultimate-year students to apply for its 2027 Engineering Summer Analyst programme at the Sydney office, joining teams building massively scalable trading systems, data engineering platforms, and machine learning infrastructure. The 9–10 week programme provides full immersion in Goldman Sachs' technology stack across front-to-back engineering.

jobs.title: AI Engineer / Data Scientist (Agentic AI)
jobs.snippet: PwC Australia's AI Centre of Excellence is hiring a Senior-level AI Engineer / Data Scientist specialising in Agentic AI to lead client delivery across intelligent automation and enterprise AI platform builds. You'll architect and deploy autonomous AI agents for clients in financial services, government, and energy, and help grow PwC's AI engineering capability.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer

You'll build ML models and algorithmic solutions to automate freight logistics processes and improve predictive analytics across global trade data spanning millions of shipments.

jobs.title: Quantitative Research Intern 2026/27
jobs.snippet: IMC Trading's Quantitative Research Internship 2026/27 in Sydney offers students the opportunity to apply machine learning, statistics, and data science to real-world trading challenges at one of the world's leading market makers. Interns work alongside senior quant researchers to develop algorithmic trading strategies and analyse market microstructure data.

jobs.title: Data Scientist: AI and Machine Learning
jobs.snippet: CSIRO is seeking a Data Scientist specialising in AI and Machine Learning to join its Data61 research team in Perth. You'll develop and apply ML and statistical models to scientific research problems across environmental science, resources, or health, using Python-based frameworks including TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch.

jobs.title: Principal Platform Engineer – Data & AI
jobs.snippet: ResMed is hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to architect and lead its Data and AI Platform, powering sleep health and respiratory disease management solutions for tens of millions of patients globally. You'll design scalable data infrastructure and AI systems integrating device telemetry, clinical outcomes, and personalised intervention models.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.snippet: Lendi Group, operator of Australia's #1 digital mortgage brand Lendi and the Aussie Home Loans franchise, is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to build and optimise its GenAI Platform as part of its AI-native transformation. You'll work with LLMs, agentic frameworks, and modern AI tooling to make home loan processing faster and smarter for brokers and borrowers.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer

Based in Canberra, you'll work on deep learning models deployed in automotive, aviation, and heavy equipment safety systems used by customers in 70+ countries.

jobs.title: Intern – Machine Learning Engineer

Interns contribute to production ML systems powering automated bank reconciliation, cash flow predictions, and AI-assisted bookkeeping features across Xero's global small business platform.
